decisions.reason: Acceptance of the website breakpoint guidance does not change the independently specified dashboard-shell styling requirement.
The breakpoint decision does not alter the website's dark-theme requirement; the separate theme clause already has its own same-message Event.
The breakpoint decision does not modify whether the footer is shared across website pages; that separate clause already has its own same-message Event.
The landing page remains required to be responsive unchanged; the accepted reusable breakpoint basis is independently represented by the source Requirement.
